text_block_list.text: After the Selection Race, the sight of Gold City running alongside the riverbank stayed etched in my mind…
Wanted to know more about her. Walking through academy grounds with that in mind—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: *pant*. Alright, new personal best! Next run, let's bump up the pace…
She was laser-focused on training, so approaching felt wrong. Interrupting would be rude. Decided to talk later—

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Nice~! What an incredible stride you have, City-chan!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh…? Who're you?

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Just as you see, I'm a trainer! I came to scout you!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh, scout me? …For real?
…Damn it. Beaten to the punch!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, no... Um.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So, if scouting me, got pitch or goals or whatever?

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'll make you top horse girl!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'll make you top horse girl!

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Nobody can look away! Turf's shining #1 horse girl, Gold City! That's my vision!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, trial period, so guess I can tag along for bit?

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Great! Tomorrow at practice time! Gonna get busy, see ya!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait, leaving already?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Fast... said his piece and bolted. Rush type?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ..."Nobody look away" "Shining on turf", huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Argh, can't take it! Can't wait! No way!
Gold City bolted! Worried, chased after her.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haha, alright! Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Didn't get good result, thought maybe next time... but scout came! Hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...They exist. People seeing real me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: From here. With these legs... I'm really running...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Take G1s, conquer all! Gonna carve my name with own power...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, can't get carried away. Took 5th in Debut Selection, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Back to practice... wait, whoa?
Oops! Gold City spotted me...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait, you, saw before race... wait, by chance...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Just now... heard that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, you kidding me?! Eavesdropping, unbelievable!
Apologized frantically, explained came to scout, followed out of worry...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. Followed 'cause worried, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. Fine, drop it. Feels like I'm bullying you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Forget what saw, swear to keep mouth shut, we're good.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me you can't even do that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Discussion over. Going back to practice, do whatever.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Saying "came to scout" now too late anyway. Got trainer already.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ugh, looking so bummed. What's with you...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Apologizing looking ready to cry... too honest, or just can't lie?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, not my problem...
choice_data_list: But that’s good enough, I’m cheering for you!
But that’s good enough, I’m cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Th-thanks. Don't get trainer cheering other girl though.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Like, what I don't get is—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why didn't talk to me? Sounded like reached track first.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yet let other guy cut in front?
choice_data_list: I can’t get in the way of your concentration…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Seriously? Ahahaha.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Way too nice. Type that loses at life.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Well, cheer if want. Later.
